## Sources & results

Explanations are based on the [Maryland State Board of Elections’ official question entries](https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/ballot_questions.html). The linked page also provides authorizing legislation and amendment documents. Wording was checked November 5, 2026.

Certified vote shares use votes cast **For** or **Against** each question, excluding blank and invalid responses. Maryland questions use statewide totals; city questions use Baltimore City totals. Percentages are rounded to one decimal place.
